test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is India’s first indigenously developed COVID-19 vaccine?
solution: The correct answer is __**COVAXIN.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • COVAXIN India's first indigenous vaccine against COVID-19. • Hyderabad-based **Bharat Biotech** has developed Covaxin. • It is done in collaboration with the **Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and the National Institute of Virology (NIV).**
